description: Carriage vectors for the record push binding over MCP and A2A (open point RP-1). Kinds: push (what a receiver does with a tool call or Message: hand the decoded octets to SF section 6, or answer an error and no answer object), classify (what a sender received, classified by the answer position alone), declaration (the tool definition and the extension entry). They pin nothing about records, stamp proofs, the push rule or the answers' values.
